title: Dreamer’s title dream lasts only minutes
summary: Mike Awesome’s departure creates an extraordinary championship handoff involving three promotions. Tommy Dreamer finally wins ECW’s top prize, only for Justin Credible to immediately take it away.

chapters.title: Taz brings the championship back
chapters.result: Taz defeats Awesome for the ECW World title.
chapters.context: Awesome is now with WCW and Taz with WWE; their ECW match resolves the championship’s immediate uncertainty.

chapters.title: Dreamer wins, then loses the championship
chapters.result: Dreamer defeats Taz, then loses the belt to Credible the same night.
chapters.context: Francine’s betrayal helps turn Dreamer’s long-awaited triumph into another personal setback.
